title: Fill
description: Makes an element as wide as its container allows, using the property that actually governs width in the parent's layout

ignoreMaxWidth.description: Override an inherited max-width. Off by default: a cap set by a variant class or design token is usually a deliberate constraint, and 'as wide as possible' still means 'as wide as you are allowed to be'. Turn this on when the cap is the thing in the way.
